request:
镜头 s03：纪录片空镜，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：degraded consumer home video recorded in 2048 on a cheap handheld family camera: soft breathing autofocus, auto-exposure blooming in the sunlight, warm faded colour with a beige cast, mild compression blocking and low-light noise, slight motion blur, intimate unsteady framing, soft diffused daylight with no harsh shadows
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary establishing shot on a long zoom lens, atmospheric haze
导演意图（自然语言）：家用摄像机，缓慢推近窗口，轻微晃动。午后空无一人的厨房，阳光和灰尘落在摆着蜡笔和画纸的餐桌上；窗外远处的地平线上，一座巨大的行星发动机还包在脚手架和塔吊里。环境声：窗外城市的远声、风、远处工地隐约的金属敲击声。
情绪：calm, nostalgic, foreboding
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot, handheld home camera with one slow push in toward the window
景深与虚实：Soft home-video focus; the room slightly soft, the window view blooming with haze.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Establishing view of the Song family's empty kitchen on a warm afternoon in 2048, filmed on the family's home camera: sunlight and dust motes over the wooden table with crayons and drawing paper; through the window, far away on the hazy horizon, the half-built steel scaffold of a colossal planetary engine tower wrapped in construction cranes; the sun is still high in the sky. Blocking lock: the wooden table with crayons and paper in the lower foreground, the fridge with children's drawings at frame left, the window at frame right with the scaffolded engine tower on the horizon.
Picture 2: the Song family kitchen on the surface in 2048 (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of a small family apartment kitchen on the Earth's surface in 2048, late afternoon: warm sunlight through a window falls across a wooden table with crayons and sheets of drawing paper, a rice cooker and a teapot on the counter, children's drawings stuck on the fridge, a potted plant; through the window a hazy city skyline and, far away on the horizon, the half-built steel scaffold of a colossal engine tower with construction cranes. Empty of people, lived-in.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：distant city hum through the window, a light breeze, faint far-off clang of construction metal
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, degraded consumer home video recorded in 2048 on a cheap handheld family camera: soft breathing autofocus, auto-exposure blooming in the sunlight, warm faded colour with a beige cast, mild compression blocking and low-light noise, slight motion blur, intimate unsteady framing, soft diffused daylight with no harsh shadows; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot, handheld home camera with one slow push in toward the window, drifting from wide shot to a slightly tighter medium wide shot as the window grows in frame; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the wooden table with crayons and drawing paper in the lower foreground, the fridge with children's drawings at frame left, the window with the scaffolded engine tower at frame right, the room empty of people. Start: the camera sits low over the table edge, autofocus hunting faintly between the crayons in the near foreground and the bright window, dust motes turning slowly in the slanted afternoon sunlight. Middle: the operator's weight shifts and the frame sways gently, then eases forward; the table drifts out of the bottom of frame as the window fills more of the picture, the auto-exposure blooming and settling as the bright glass takes over, faint clamps of cranes visible against the pale sky and the steel lattice of the engine tower rising in layers of scaffold. End: the push settles with the window centred right of frame, the tower small and hazy on the horizon, the focus breathing once and holding on the distant structure, the last sunlight flaring softly at the edge of the glass. Mood: calm, nostalgic, foreboding. Blur: the near table and crayons fall soft and out of focus as the lens moves; the window view blooms with haze, the far scaffold slightly soft, the frame edges losing definition in the home-video optics. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

Room tone of an empty kitchen, a faint electrical hum from the fridge, the distant city hum coming through the window glass, a light breeze stirring outside, a faint far-off clang of construction metal from the horizon, dust-quiet air and the small handling rustle of the camera body; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
